name: GeneNetWeaver dynamical network
description: GeneNetWeaver dynamical network XML/SBML model consumed by the GNW CLI with --simulate --input-net. The file stores the gene list, signed regulatory structure and kinetic parameters used to simulate expression benchmarks.
example:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<sbml xmlns="http://www.sbml.org/sbml/level2" level="2" version="1">
  <model name="InSilicoSize10-Example">
    <listOfSpecies>
      <species id="G1" name="G1" compartment="cell" />
      <species id="G2" name="G2" compartment="cell" />
    </listOfSpecies>
  </model>
</sbml>
validation_notes: The file must be accepted by GeneNetWeaver's --simulate loader as a dynamical network model.
Species identifiers in the SBML model define the public gene universe after wrapper normalization.
Synthesis reactions and modifier species encode the regulatory edges that GNW exports to *_goldstandard.tsv and *_goldstandard_signed.tsv.
The wrapper must preserve a copy of the input XML under provenance/raw/ because the XML contains kinetic parameters that affect expression but are not fully represented in truth/networks.csv.
